descricao_resumida: A bolt from the sky that strikes down any military unit.
descricao_avancada: Deals 10,000 divine damage to the target unit, or 2,500 divine damage if the target unit is a Titan. This power cannot be used on (Villager, Worker, Gatherer, Dwarf, Citizen, Peasant) economic units, (Transport Ship, Roca, Leviathan) transport units, Ox Carts, Dragontale Qilins, Regents, or starting Berserk of Norse players.

descricao_resumida: Target a spot to erect a special rock that attracts animals to it and spawns chickens. The Attraction summons more Food in later ages and Villagers can leave Food at the Attraction.
descricao_avancada: Creates a structure that attracts animals and acts as a barn, as well as raising chickens. After attracting a defined amount of food, the bait no longer functions as an attractant.

descricao_resumida: Use in an Urban Center, Village Center or in your or an ally's Fortress to protect it with stone guardians.
descricao_avancada: Summons five Sentinels, immobile stone giants armed with bows, around your own or allied Town Centers. In Retold, up to 3 wards can be created in a row at each location around a single Town Center.

descricao_resumida: Target anywhere to make all your Villagers collect Food from Farms faster.
descricao_avancada: For 45 seconds, only the player who summons will experience a 150% increase in Farm collection rates.

descricao_resumida: Use anywhere to make all your Villagers and Trade Caravan gather ours faster
descricao_avancada: For 50 seconds, Workers will collect gold 80% faster. In Retold, Caravans' gold collection rate will also increase by 20% for the duration of the effect.

descricao_resumida: Use a hidden region on the map to temporarily reveal it.
descricao_avancada: Reveals the target area and dispels the Fog of War for the player and their allies for 20 seconds.

descricao_resumida: Select a location to create a new Gold Mine that has more Gold and faster collection if used in later ages.
descricao_avancada: Creates a mystical Gold Mine at the target location. The amount of gold in the mine depends on the era in which this power is used.

descricao_resumida: Use a group of wild animals to greatly multiply your numbers. If there are none, Odin will summon some of them. It gets more powerful every season.
descricao_avancada: Causes animals in the target area to multiply. Its power increases with each Age. If there are no animals, some Elks are spawned.

descricao_resumida: Use an enemy unit to secretly see what it sees.
descricao_avancada: The power can be used on a target enemy unit to reveal its Line of Sight until it is killed. The power cannot be used on a (which reveals Line of Sight to all players anyway) Titan. Unlike other divine powers, the game does not display a notification when a player invokes this power.

descricao_resumida: Use it at a location on the map to send enemy units flying and stun them for a few seconds.
descricao_avancada: Generates a shockwave that deals light damage and scatters enemy units within a relatively small radius. Scattered units are also stunned for several seconds.

descricao_resumida: Select a location to grow a Gaia Forest. Villagers collected wood faster from Gaia's trees.
descricao_avancada: Creates a forest of aspens, which contain more wood than other trees. Citizens collect wood from these trees at a higher rate. Trees can also be placed strategically to create a barrier that is difficult for other players to overcome.

descricao_resumida: Use on an enemy building to deconstruct it. The target player will receive their resources back, but will lose the building.
descricao_avancada: Immediately begins the process of reversing the construction of a target enemy building. The owner will recover the resource cost of the deconstructed building. This power cannot be used in Town Halls, Wonders, Titan Gates and buildings summoned with divine powers.

descricao_resumida: Target a location to create Peach Blossom Spring, whose resource pool increases over time. Peach Blossom Fountain resources are obtained very quickly, but their supply increases when a villager begins his collection.
descricao_avancada: Generates a Peach Blossom Fountain in the summoned area. It automatically accumulates your resource stock over time and can be switched between collecting food, wood or gold. However, its stock stops increasing when a villager collects resources from it.

descricao_resumida: Target a location to create a number of Clay Peasants that last a few minutes. Generates more peasants in later eras.
descricao_avancada: Spawns a variable number of Clay Peasants that function like regular Peasants, but eventually decay after a short period of time. 2/4/8/12/30 are generated in the Archaic/Classical/Heroic/Mythic/Wonder Ages, respectively.

descricao_resumida: Target 2 Farms to sow butterfly seeds. They will produce food faster, heal nearby villagers, and turn allied units invisible.
descricao_avancada: Transforms 2 Farms into Shennong Farms, with triple health, 40% faster food collection rate than normal Farms, a healing effect for nearby villagers, and the ability to turn allied units positioned on them invisible.

descricao_resumida: Target one of your (or your allies') Town Centers to summon and command Frey's golden boar, Gullinbursti, to defend an area. Gullinbursti becomes stronger with each era.
descricao_avancada: Can be used as a target in the City Center itself or in an allied Center to summon Gullinbursti for a set period, a powerful unit of heroes whose power and attributes increase with each Age.

descricao_resumida: Select a unit to temporarily make it nearly invulnerable
descricao_avancada: For 10 seconds, the target unit gains a 300 rechargeable (+300 with each advancement of era) shield and is healed at 25 HP/s.

descricao_resumida: Target a building to obtain up to 3 free technologies per launch, prioritizing the most expensive all freely available technologies and making military units train faster for a short period.
descricao_avancada: Target 1 building to get up to 3 freely available technologies and make military units train faster for a short period. This lasts 10sec. And the technology remains

descricao_resumida: Select a location for Susanoo to launch his sword, Kusanagi. The sword deals damage to nearby enemies and summons a current that launches them into the air.
descricao_avancada: Launches a divine sword that damages enemies and summons a current that repels units. Has -50% bonus damage against villagers.

descricao_resumida: For 30 seconds, all combat is prohibited, and the construction of Towers, Keeps, Migdol Keeps, Hillforts, Palaces, and Castles is halted. However, offensive divine powers can still be invoked during this period.
descricao_avancada: For 30 seconds, all combat is prohibited, and the construction of Towers, Keeps, Migdol Keeps, Hillforts, Palaces, and Castles is halted. However, offensive divine powers can still be invoked during this period.

Allied units and buildings in the target area will quickly recover health for 8 seconds. Outside of combat, this power can almost instantly restore any normal unit to full health. The recovery rate is greatly reduced during combat.
Buildings in the target area will slow down units and prevent attack for 60 seconds. However, this power does not affect City Centers.

Creates two tunnel portals at target locations. Units that enter one portal are instantly transported to the other. Portals can be destroyed by enemy units, and destroying a portal will cause its counterpart to collapse as well.
Turns all human soldiers, mythical (except Titans) units, and player ships in the target area bronze for 40 seconds, reducing their hacking and piercing vulnerabilities by -35%.

Transforms random enemy units in the target area into pigs, with an upper limit on the resource cost of the transformed units. This power does not affect mythic* units or heroes, and has a reduced impact on Villagers

Creates a Vault that generates 4 units of food, wood and gold every second. The Vault cannot be destroyed. Instead, it can be captured by enemy units and will be taken by the player who has the most units near the Vault.

Creates a violent storm in the target area. Lightning can hit enemy units, causing them great damage. The more units there are in the area, the greater the damage caused. This power does not affect own or allied (before Retold , it also did not affect flying units) units and is less effective against structures.

Deals massive amounts of crushing damage over a wide area in the target area - with more damage being dealt in the center of the area of ​​effect and less at the edges. This power has no effect on Farms.

For 55 seconds, creates a darkness over the entire map, which increases the player's Mythic Units and Landmarks. Mythic units gain +20% attack (including skills), -60% skill cooldown, +15% movement speed, and -10% slashing / -10% piercing / -10% crushing vulnerabilities. Monuments gain +50% favor gain rate. Prior to Retold, on the other divine powers can be summoned by any player while Eclipse is in effect.

Instantly transport a group of allied units from one target location on the map to another. Before Retold, this could be used to move friendly and enemy units; however, enemy units to be transported were randomly selected, with a much lower chance of being transported compared to allied units.

Summons allied Serpents to protect the target location. The player has no control over the snakes, but shares their Line of Sight. If this power is invoked in water, Sea Serpents will be summoned in its place.

Summons a swarm of locusts to attack in the indicated direction. The swarm will damage all units and buildings, as well as dealing heavy damage to Villagers and Fishing Boats, as well as quickly destroying Farms, Fruit Bushes and animals. Before Retold, it did not damage other units or buildings, but was very effective in devastating the opponent's economy. It affected a single area and moved randomly. In Retold, the power used a directional target, and the swarm moved in a straight line.

Resurrects the dead for 55 seconds at the target location. On land, Minions will be summoned, while on water, Lost Ships will appear. Ancestors are gradually resurrected and will be dismissed together when the effect expires.

Transforms the target allied Town Center into a Citadel Center, a durable structure with significantly increased attack, hit points, armor, and work rate. The Citadel also supports additional population. In Retold, each civilization uses its own unique architecture for the Citadel rather than always appearing in Egyptian design, with the only difference being the main statue of the god.

Transforms the target Pharaoh into a Son of Osiris, a unit with greatly increased attack and hit points, as well as a greater magnitude of power, that uses a lightning chain attack that can hit up to four units at once. A Son of Osiris cannot be healed, and when he dies, an ordinary Pharaoh will replace him. In Retold, it is possible to cast this power again to have multiple Sons of Osiris at the same time.

For 20 seconds, meteors will fall over the target area. The first impact will be in the center of the target, with subsequent impacts spreading out randomly. Meteor impacts deal massive amounts of damage to structures and launch units into the air, dealing moderate damage to them. Meteors can damage allied units and structures, although not to the same extent as enemies.
Creates a violent tornado for 20 seconds at the target location, which spreads in a spiral, causing heavy damage to units and structures. The tornado will deal damage to both enemy and allied units.

Ignites trees in the target location, spreading to other trees in a limited radius before they fall. Enemy units and buildings near the flames take damage, while own and allied units and buildings are immune.

Creates a shockwave that damages walls, towers, city centers, and fortresses. Crumble is powerful enough to instantly destroy walls and towers, but does limited damage to city centers and fortresses. In Retold, the power uses a directional target.

Creates a healing fountain that heals idle self and friendly units within range at a rate of 2.5 health per second, slower for non-idle units. The source cannot be destroyed. Instead, it can be captured by enemy units and will be taken by the player who has the most units near the source.
Animates random trees in the target area. Walking Forests will attack enemy units and buildings. Prior to patch 2.7, they could not be controlled by the player.
For 50 seconds, all enemy units in the target area will be frozen in place but will have 99% armor, making them nearly invulnerable to any attacks during this period.
When summoned, all of the player's human units, ships, and heroes on the map will have 60% increased attack for 45 seconds.

Instantly converts all Collectors and Dwarves on the map into Heroes of Ragnarok, melee infantry units with a huge bonus against mythic units, but unable to collect resources or build Farms. This power essentially sacrifices the player's economy for an instant army.

For 31 seconds, multiple packs of Fimbulwinter Wolves will appear next to enemy Town Centers, Town Centers, or Settlements. The player has no control over the wolves, and they are dismissed when the effect expires. In the original game, no other divine powers can be invoked by any player while Fimbulwinter is in effect.

Summons the powerful dragon Nidhogg to serve the player. Nidhogg is particularly resilient and quite effective against buildings, dealing group damage against groups of enemy units. He is particularly vulnerable to ranged attacks from heroes, towers, and Fortress-type buildings, and cannot be healed in any way.

Places spider eggs in the target area, which will eventually hatch and burrow into the ground. Enemy human units will be killed by spiders as they traverse the area. Eggs can be killed by enemies before they hatch. In Retold, this power uses a directional target.

This power instantly transforms Atlantean units into heroes. In the original game, a group of units can be converted. In Retold, this power only affects one unit, but instantly restores its full health.
Summons an amphibious carnivorous plant at target location (land or water). The plant is stationary, but can devour (and sink ships before of Retold) soldiers who approach it.

Instantly grants the player control of a selected enemy unit. Cannot be used on economic units, Titans, heroes and other units such as transport units. In the original game, units converted by Traitor will immediately have 85% of their maximum health, regardless of their pre-conversion health. In Retold, units converted by Traitor will no longer take damage when converted.

In the original game, this power immediately converts a group of enemy units in the target area to Mother Nature, making them hostile to all players. In Retold, it bestows a status effect that causes affected units to attack each other. The duration depends on the number of units affected; the more units affected, the shorter the duration of the divine power.

Immediately builds a Tree of Hesperides, where up to 5 (per tree) Dryads can be created. In the original game, the tree also protects against divine powers within range, but this effect was removed in Retold and replaced with an ability that heals nearby mythical units and spawns 2 free Dryads when summoned. The tree cannot be destroyed. Instead, it can be captured by enemy or allied units and will be taken by the player who has the most units near the tree.

Creates a spherical "black hole", which sucks in and damages nearby units ( exceto units voadoras ) and then explodes, damaging all nearby units and substantial damage to structures. Final explosion damage increases as more units are sucked in.
Instantly teleports all owned military units across the map to the target location.

Instantly opens a portal to the underworld at the target location, spawning neutral creatures hostile to all players. The portal also instantly destroys any building it is thrown at, except City Centers, Wonders, and Titan Gates.
Turns all allied units within 20 meters invisible for 30 seconds. Invisibility lasts until the divine power ends or invisible units attack any enemy.
Grants all of the player's human soldiers, ships, and heroes a chance to stun enemy units for 15 seconds.

When summoned to an allied building, a circular wall of sturdy earth rises from the ground in a 40 radius to trap or keep enemies at bay. The walls erected start with 50% health and slowly increase, passing through obstacles such as trees or other buildings.
When summoned to an allied building, plants sprout from the nearby ground within a 30 radius, healing allied units and immobilizing and dealing momentary damage to nearby enemy units.
Reduces the health of enemy buildings within a radius of 30 by 10%, making them even more vulnerable to damage. Construction and repairs in the target area are also disabled.
Spawns seven Feis to attack enemy units and infect them with diseases.
Creates a fast-moving wave that sweeps away enemy units and devastates enemy buildings in its path.

Summons Yinglong, the legendary winged rain dragon, to serve the player. Yinglong is particularly resilient and quite effective against units and structures, inflicts divine damage with his lightning and has an aura effect that boosts allied Farms and slows down enemy units below him. He is particularly vulnerable to ranged attacks from heroes, towers, and Fortress-type structures, and cannot be healed in any way.
Darkens the sky and causes flaming rocks to bombard the target area, dealing 25 damage to everything in an area.
Place an Asgardian Hill Fort at the target location, which will start building at 50%. Builders can be tasked with constructing the building faster.
Summons a blizzard that rains down icicles, damaging units, reducing their movement speed, and increasing their cooldown.

Summons Fenrir, who will charge in the indicated direction. Fenrir will incinerate everything in its path, dealing slashing damage to everything it touches, setting trees on fire, and disappearing in a large, powerful explosion.

descricao_resumida: Select a location to summon a Goshinboku tree. The tree's blessing resurrects the owner's mythic units as they fall in combat.
descricao_avancada: Creates a Goshinboku Tree that revives fallen mythical units, up to two at a time; cannot respawn Kitsune, Titans, flying units, or certain untrainable mythic units. The tree cannot be destroyed, but it can be captured by any player who has the most units near it.

descricao_resumida: Select a Sanctuary to transform it into a Hunting Sanctuary, periodically spawning huntable deer as well as friendly wolves that defend the area
descricao_avancada: Transforms a Sanctuary into a Hunting Sanctuary, which spawns huntable deer and guardian wolves; acts as a drop site

descricao_resumida: Select a location to create a temporary Kappa-infested swamp that will leap out of the water and drown enemy human soldiers
descricao_avancada: Creates a Kappa-infested 18-radius swamp that periodically drowns enemy human soldiers who come near them

descricao_resumida: Choose a Daimyo to transform into an immensely powerful Shogun who summons Samurais as he fights.
descricao_avancada: Transforms a Daimyo into a Shogun, which is more powerful and generates Samurai in combat

descricao_resumida: Aim at a location to release earth-shattering shockwaves. Raijin strikes his den-den daiko drums, creating rings of lightning that expand and damage and stun enemies.
descricao_avancada: Creates four shockwaves that damage and throw units within a successive expansion radius of 20 to 35, knocking back enemy units and damaging units and buildings. Has -50% bonus damage against villagers.

descricao_resumida: Aim in one direction to release a huge gust of wind, destroying military units across the map
descricao_avancada: Explodes units, both allies and enemies, far towards the target; flying units, workers and animals (such as pastoral animals, huntable animals and animals of Set) are not affected

descricao_resumida: Create a path of destruction. Takemikazuchi will cut through the earth with a colossal katana slash, dealing massive damage to units and stunning survivors
descricao_avancada: Deals damage to enemy units in an area 8 wide and 30 long, knocking back and stunning survivors

descricao_resumida: Select a location to erect a large Torii Gate that makes your Divine Powers cheaper and allows you to summon them again for free
descricao_avancada: Creates a Sacred Gate that makes all (except the Sacred Byton) divine powers immediately available one more time, at on the cost, and reduces its reuse cost by 20%. The Gate cannot be destroyed, but it can be captured by any player who has the most units near it.

descricao_resumida: Aim for a path of destruction. Watatsumi will descend in dragon form and explode into a swirling typhoon, destroying everything in its path.
descricao_avancada: Deals damage to enemies in a moving circular area of ​​radius 25; moves 60 pieces in a duration of 12 seconds

descricao_resumida: Unleashes devastation in the target area, drying out berries, plants, and trees, and turning the land into an arid desert where nothing can grow for a short period of time.
creates a peaceful field that stops all attacks from units and buildings hit by its glow
Provides bonuses to defensive strength and resources, and can convert enemy units to your side
Revive the last 100 fallen units as spectral Eidolons under your control, at the cost of all City Centers you own
Target any unit to grant it immense power for a short duration. When the effect ends, the unit dies, granting you Favor.
Target any player to secretly copy their Archaic Age God Power.
Target a group of friendly units to boost their movement speed for a short duration.
Target a location to spawn a sacred Agave. Gather it for Food or let its sacred energy heal your nearby units.
Target a location to summon an Infested Nest that periodically spawns Scorpions that obey your commands.
Target a group of enemies to put them to sleep. Any damage dealt to sleeping units will wake them up immediately.
Target an enemy military unit to mark it for sacrifice. The unit is suspended in the air, and after a short delay, all nearby enemies of the same type are destroyed.
Target a location to bombard enemies with falling stars. Tzitzimitl star demons occasionally emerge from the craters to fight for you.
Target a location to summon Tlaltecuhtli, the Earth Monster. It erupts from the ground repeatedly to swallow groups of units, trapping them underground before regurgitating survivors.
Target a location to raise a mighty Volcano. It obliterates buildings as it rises, and bombards the surrounding area with molten rock.
Target an area to corrupt the earth. Defeated enemies here will be reborn as vile abominations that fight for you.
Target a location to call down the Pillar of Tlálocan, obliterating fortifications on impact. The statue remains to defend the area with water strikes until destroyed.
